title: Protect a valid baseline attempt
instructions: Choose the action that preserves useful baseline evidence. This is not the protected baseline form.

parts.prompt: Which condition gives the most useful first-attempt baseline?

options.text: Use translation tools for difficult sentences.
Ask a friend for hints.
Work without hints, AI, translation or references.
Preview the answers first, then attempt the questions.

parts.correct_explanation: Independent conditions make the result interpretable.

parts.prompt: The browser disconnects during a saved baseline. What should happen?

options.text: Search online for the questions' answers while waiting.
Resume the same saved session and record the interruption.
Start repeatedly and keep the best.
Ask someone else to finish the remaining questions.

choice_rationales.D: That is not the learner's work.

parts.correct_explanation: Documented recovery is safer than replacement.

parts.prompt: What may the baseline legitimately support?

options.text: A guaranteed prediction of scholarship admission.
A starting profile of sampled strengths and needs.
A permanent label of the learner's ability.
A regional ranking.

choice_rationales.A: It is not validated for that.

parts.correct_explanation: The baseline guides what to study next.

parts.prompt: Which limitation belongs beside an objective result?

options.text: It does not directly measure a complete composition.
It measures every English skill, including speaking.
It replaces all later practice and checkpoints.
It predicts the essay prompt.

parts.correct_explanation: Objective items cannot substitute for full writing.

parts.prompt: How should later progress be checked?

options.text: Repeat identical items until memorised.
Use a matched fresh form covering the same outcomes.
Use an unrelated word game with different skills.
Choose only easy items that were answered correctly.

choice_rationales.A: Remembered answers would hide real growth.

parts.hint: Keep the same skills and question types, but use new items.
parts.correct_explanation: Parallel evidence supports a fairer comparison.
